categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the aortic and peripheral vascular intervention medical devices sector. Main business segments include aortic stent systems (thoracic and abdominal aortic endovascular grafts), intraoperative stent systems for aortic dissection surgery, and peripheral vascular intervention products including balloon catheters and vascular stents. The company also has emerging business in tumor intervention through its subsidiary Tuomai Medical.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in endovascular stent system design and manufacturing, including branched stent preparation technology, ultra-low profile system manufacturing (18F and 14F), precision release mechanisms, soft sheath crossing technology, laser engraving for stent fabrication, and drug-coated balloon catheter spiral layer spray coating technology. Manufacturing follows strict quality management systems including YY/T0287-2017 and EN ISO13485:2016 standards, with production based on sales forecasts and inventory management principles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are hospitals and medical institutions across China, with the company's products covering over 2,100 hospitals nationwide. Key end markets include treatment of aortic aneurysms, aortic dissection, peripheral arterial disease, and venous diseases. The company serves patients requiring minimally invasive endovascular intervention procedures. International markets include 31 countries across Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with products covering all 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. International presence spans 31 countries including Singapore, multiple European nations, Turkey, and Brazil. The company has established distribution networks in second, third, and fourth-tier Chinese cities and is expanding overseas market penetration, with international sales growing over 55% year-over-year.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It manufactures finished medical devices and sells primarily through a distribution model to hospitals and medical institutions. The company controls design, manufacturing, quality control, and distribution, with upstream involvement in raw material procurement (medical-grade nickel-titanium, PET polymers, contrast agents) from both domestic and international suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous product innovation and R&D investment (21.94% of revenue in 2023). Strategic focus includes: expanding aortic product portfolio with multi-branch stent systems and ultra-low profile designs; developing peripheral vascular intervention products (venous stents, vena cava filters, thrombectomy devices); advancing tumor intervention capabilities (TIPS stent systems, microspheres); and pursuing customized medical device solutions. The company aims to transition from technology follower to technology leader.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales via a distribution model. Distributors purchase products at factory prices and resell to hospitals and medical institutions. Revenue comes from sales of aortic stent systems (79.1% of revenue), intraoperative stent systems (11.1%), and peripheral/other products (9.7%). Domestic sales represent 93.1% of revenue with international sales at 6.9%. The company uses buy-and-hold distribution agreements with distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In aortic intervention, the company holds the leading domestic market position with absolute competitive advantage. Key international competitors include Medtronic, Boston Scientific, Abbott, and Gore. In peripheral vascular intervention, the company competes against established international players but has launched competitive products like Reewarm PTX drug-coated balloon catheter. The company is ranked among leading domestic medical device enterprises in entering special review pathways with 8 products in innovation channels.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2023 revenue of RMB 1,187.2 million (32.4% YoY growth) with net profit of RMB 492.4 million (38.0% YoY growth). Total assets reached RMB 4,246.2 million (112.8% increase from 2022), with net assets of RMB 3,843.8 million (123.7% increase). Operating cash flow was RMB 558.3 million (67.3% increase). The company demonstrates strong profitability with 76.45% gross margin and 26.43% ROE, maintaining consistent high-growth trajectory over three years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation and clinical advancement as core value propositions. Key differentiators include: first global branched aortic stent (Castor) for aortic arch disease treatment; ultra-low profile delivery systems enabling better navigability; proprietary drug-coated balloon technology with unique spiral-layer spray coating; intraoperative stent systems (only domestic product approved for aortic dissection surgery); and comprehensive product portfolio addressing multiple vascular pathologies. The company positions itself as providing accessible, high-quality, innovative solutions for blood circulation disease treatment.
